prior_proposal.notes: Static proposal only; no tools or execution used. Original timer/duration lines 1905–1913, 1922–1928, and 1937–1943 gain MPI_MAX reductions; the existing sum and canonical output at lines 1951–1954 then consume the corrected durations. MPI_LONG exactly matches the explicitly declared long buffers, consistent with the supplied Linux x86_64 LP64 platform evidence. Existing CUDA synchronization completes GPU work before each stop.

prior_independent_review.timed_region: Precomputation lines 1900-1911; simulation lines 1918-1927; distance computation lines 1934-1943. Each phase starts after a barrier, encloses its complete work, synchronizes CUDA work, and includes the existing ending barrier.
prior_independent_review.rank_aggregation: Each local long duration is reduced with MPI_MAX across MPI_COMM_WORLD at lines 1911, 1927, and 1943. The target LP64 evidence establishes MPI_LONG matches long.
prior_independent_review.collective_safety: All ranks execute matching MPI_Barrier and MPI_Allreduce calls on MPI_COMM_WORLD with count 1, MPI_LONG, and MPI_MAX. Existing phase collectives are also matched.
prior_independent_review.canonical_output: Total computation time at line 1954 uses totalTime, the sum of the three reduced phase maxima at line 1951, reported in milliseconds. The derived per-triangle metric at line 1969 uses the same corrected total.
prior_independent_review.scope_assessment: The RNG-modulus construction remains present but is moved into the timed precomputation at lines 1903-1905; no algorithmic result, inputs, iteration counts, validation, or non-timing behavior is changed.

evidence.finding: Precomputation includes RNG-modulus construction, time-delay computation, form-factor computation, CUDA completion, the ending barrier, and MPI_MAX aggregation.
Simulation duration encloses runSimulation, whose CUDA work is completed before the ending barrier, and is aggregated with MPI_MAX.
Distance duration encloses computeDistances, including CUDA synchronization and MPI gathering, and is aggregated with MPI_MAX.
Canonical total and directly derived timing metric consume the corrected phase durations.

prior_independent_review.notes: Accepted for the supplied Linux x86_64 LP64 target: the dossier states long is 8 bytes and the duration buffers use MPI_LONG. No simultaneous start is required because complete local durations are reduced with MPI_MAX.

revision_trigger: operator timing-only scope review; prior Luna acceptance is retained unchanged

operator_scope_review.finding: The original initializeSimulation executes RNG polynomial preparation in one of two OpenMP sections, concurrently with mesh/octree initialization (original lines 1296-1316). The proposal removes that section and executes the same work serially in main after initialization. This unnecessarily changes the existing work placement/overlap, contrary to the timing-only requirement to preserve decomposition.
operator_scope_review.required_revision: Keep the RNG preparation call in its original OpenMP section and preserve both sections. Measure the algorithmic RNG preparation in place using a non-MPI monotonic/chrono timer safe for the executing OpenMP worker; carry only its duration to the canonical total/precomputation accounting and perform the required rank aggregation outside the parallel region. Do not broaden the timer to mesh/octree/input initialization, move computational work, or change algorithmic values, placement, loops, validation or non-timing output.
other_nontrivial_changes_checked: N-body hybrid r5 adds an OpenMP barrier after the master start timestamp, gating work on timing only; the existing master block otherwise performs only MPI barrier and timestamp assignment.

QT hybrid r4 moves the start timestamp before the existing world barrier to establish a global makespan. QT hybrid r2 brings its existing setupGpu algorithmic preprocessing inside timing without changing that computation.

Cahn-Hilliard hybrid r1, QT hybrid r3/r5 and Stencil MPI r3 replace ending timing barriers with reductions of completed local durations; independent review must confirm their existing work/device-completion boundaries.

Roomsim hybrid r5 times the existing RNG construction in place; its self-test is const and consumes no reusable algorithmic state. Other Roomsim edits aggregate complete local intervals or phase durations.
The other edits are timing variables, matching MPI duration reductions, reporting and directly derived performance values.

The other 68 proposals and literal-prompt-bound reviews are reused unchanged, including the Cahn-Hilliard Luna rejection.
